newsitem.title: USA: Ohio House plans school funding votes Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Ohio House plans school funding votes Wednesday.

text.p: Ohio representatives are expected to consider an overhaul of public school funding methods Wednesday with possible votes on the House floor and in the Finance Committee, a spokeswoman said.

Finance is scheduled to meet Wednesday morning to begin considering the proposed state sales tax increase that would generate $1.1 billion annually, said Cheryl Burchard, spokeswoman for House Speaker Jo Ann Davidson, R-Reynoldsburg.

Bills designed to promote academic accountability and to require school districts to create "rainy day" funds and budget forecasts are scheduled to be heard by the full House Wednesday afternoon, Burchard said.

Tuesday, the Ohio Senate advanced the tax increase and accountability proposals, which require voter approval. Lawmakers must approve constitutional amendments by Aug 6 if the referendum questions are to be placed on the November ballot.
